topic: The messenger god of Greek mythology
core_question: Who is the messenger of the Greek gods, known for his winged sandals?
answer_summary: Accept 'Hermes' — the Greek god of travel, trade, and messenger of the gods.
persona: tired and blunt; writing terse one-liners
